title: 01 Fellrise: notes
strengths: One number mid-stride: a 68 px italic pace with the delta to plan, then one picture: an elevation profile with the climb hatched, the summit flagged and the runner marked.
Watch conventions held: time top right, corner insets respected, pure black for OLED, four sizes in one family.
Specific data: KM 14.2, −0:08 to plan, +312 m, 2.1 km to the summit.
slop_signals: Seven data points plus a chart on a 205 × 251 display (km tag, clock, pace, delta, label, climb, distance, profile): at the edge of what one glance can take.
Hatched fill plus contour echoes behind the profile: two textures where one fill would do; the Oura and Strava live widgets use none.
fixes: Drop either the 'TO SUMMIT' label row or the km tag; let the profile carry the summit distance.
Keep the hatching, remove the contour echoes.

references.what: One yellow timer, grey labels, flat black: the workout metric hierarchy Apple uses on the watch too.
Live Activity: time, split pace, distance with labels under values and nothing drawn behind them.
Three metrics with small-caps labels under the values: the label-under-value rhythm at glance size.
Slanted metrics in one family, flat, no texture.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay

changed: Renamed Ridgeline to Fellrise: Ridgeline is a real product name (Honda Ridgeline) and NAMES.md marked it 'may be real'; no app or product called Fellrise was found
Engine system renamed with engine.py set name, then build (DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md and exports regenerated)
Page title and aria-label changed; the face itself shows no brand name, so shot.png is unchanged in pixels but was re-rendered
The folder keeps its name (01-ridgeline-trail) so links do not break
watch/sheet.html caption and iframe title renamed; sheet.png re-rendered (it also picks up Tidemark's WED 14)
